q.en: "I ___ an email right now — can you wait a minute?"
q.bn: "I ___ an email right now — can you wait a minute?"

why.en: Happening at this exact moment → present continuous.

options.en: is boiling — present continuous, it's happening now
options.bn: is boiling — present continuous, এখনই ঘটছে

options.en: boils — present simple, a general fact
has boiled — present perfect, an experience
has been boiling — present perfect continuous
options.bn: has been boiling — present perfect continuous

why.en: This is a general fact, always true, not a one-time event — present simple.
why.bn: এটা একটা general fact, সবসময় সত্য, one-time event না — present simple।

q.en: Fix the mistake: "I have finished my homework yesterday."
q.bn: ভুলটা ঠিক করো: "I have finished my homework yesterday."

options.en: I have finish my homework yesterday.
options.bn: I have finish my homework yesterday.

options.en: I am finishing my homework yesterday.
options.bn: I am finishing my homework yesterday.

why.en: "Yesterday" is a specific time word, so it must be past simple, never present perfect.
why.bn: "Yesterday" একটা specific time word, তাই এটা past simple হতে হবে, present perfect না।

q.en: "She ___ here for six months." Which tense best fits (emphasising the ongoing duration)?
q.bn: "She ___ here for six months." কোন tense ঠিক (duration-এর উপর জোর দিয়ে)?

why.en: Present perfect continuous emphasises an ongoing duration ("for six months") that is still true now.
why.bn: Present perfect continuous একটা চলমান duration-এর ("for six months") উপর জোর দেয় যেটা এখনো সত্য।

q.en: Fix the mistake: "I am understanding the lesson now."
q.bn: ভুলটা ঠিক করো: "I am understanding the lesson now."

options.en: I have understood the lesson now.
options.bn: I have understood the lesson now.

why.en: "Understand" is a stative verb (like know, want, believe) — it doesn't take the -ing continuous form.
why.bn: "Understand" একটা stative verb (know, want, believe-এর মতো) — এটা -ing continuous form নেয় না।
